description: A Perl script that performs static analysis and linting on shell script files, specifically focusing on test definitions and common shell script problems such as broken &&-chains and unclosed heredocs. It includes classes for lexing and parsing shell scripts, as well as specialized parsing for test constructs, and supports multi-threaded execution for processing multiple scripts.

classes.name: Lexer
classes.description: Perl class responsible for tokenizing POSIX shell scripts, including handling here-docs, strings, operators, and comments.

classes.name: ShellParser
classes.description: Recursive descent parser for POSIX shell scripts, capable of parsing command groups, subshells, control structures, functions, and command sequences.

classes.name: TestParser
classes.description: Subclass of ShellParser that adds semantic analysis for test constructs, checking for common problems like missing '&&' or '|| return 1' in test scripts.

classes.name: ScriptParser
classes.description: Subclass of ShellParser that identifies individual test definitions within scripts and passes test bodies to TestParser for problem detection.

methods.name: new
methods.description: Constructor for Lexer, ShellParser, TestParser, and ScriptParser classes.

methods.name: scan_token
methods.description: Tokenizes the input shell script, handling strings, operators, comments, and here-docs.

methods.name: parse_cmd
methods.description: Parses a command or command sequence in the shell script.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: High-level parse method that processes the entire script or test body.

methods.name: check_test
methods.description: Analyzes a test definition for problems like missing '&&' or '|| exit 1'.
